title: A chain build runs step 9b on the faults it sends beside those it never sends, and sends an uncallable phone
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: 9b runs a turn on demo words although a plan item has no slot, and does not run with only unsendable faults; phone-callable is the sent kind uncallable-phone.

tests: a chain build runs 9b on the faults it sends beside those it never sends, and hands the site over without it when it has none to send
